exposure: X-linked Charcot-Marie-Tooth type 1 (CMTX1) due to GJB1 C.622G>A mutation
outcome: diffuse abnormal signals in corpus callosum, posterior limbs of bilateral internal capsule, and centrum semiovale on MRI
cohort: A 29-year-old female patient with a history of two cesarean deliveries and confirmed X-linked Charcot-Marie-Tooth type 1.
finding: The diagnosis of CMTX1 should be considered, even in female patients, when recurrent stroke-like symptoms and abnormal white matter signals on MRI are present.
mod_finding: The puerperium after cesarean deliveries was identified as a potential precipitating factor for the patient's recurrent stroke-like symptoms.
